name: appointment-booking-monorepo
description: Top-level workspace scripts to run frontend, backend and dashboard concurrently

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd BACKEND && npm install && cd .. && cd FRONTEND && npm install && cd .. && cd dashboard && npm install
scripts.build: npm --prefix FRONTEND install && npm --prefix FRONTEND run build
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix BACKEND run server" "npm --prefix FRONTEND run dev" "npm --prefix dashboard run dev"
scripts.dev:logs: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,DASHBOARD -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix BACKEND run server" "npm --prefix FRONTEND run dev" "npm --prefix dashboard run dev"
